name: Wall of Dust
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You create a wall of choking dust within long range that is 20 ft high, 5 ft thick, and up to 100 ft long or a circular wall with a diameter of medium range. Uncheck any number of Conditions and roll Spirit to set the Difficulty.

Each creature that enters the wall, is within the wall when it's created or begins its turn within the wall must roll Fortitude against the Difficulty. On a failure, the creature takes 1d4 damage, and for the next round, it is blinded and cannot breathe. On a pass, it takes half damage.

For each Condition you unchecked (twice for Troubled and Guilty), choose one:

  • The wall becomes 20 ft longer or taller, or the diameter increases by 10 ft.

  • +1d damage.

  • Whenever you maintain concentration for this spell, you may move the wall or part of the wall an additional 5 ft in any direction you choose.

Describe how you create the wall.
successes:
✨: On a failure, the creature is blinded and cannot breathe for 1 additional round.

🌞: On a failure, the creature is blinded and cannot breathe for 1 minute.
